InstaEclipse

Instagram, the way you want it.
A Vector (Xposed) module for privacy, downloads, a cleaner feed, smarter stories and DMs, and your own look. Everything is a switch inside Instagram.

Features • Compatibility • Installation • Using it • FAQ • Contributors

---

## What is it InstaEclipse is a module for [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector), the Xposed framework formerly known as LSPosed (rooted phones), and [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) (no root). Long press the Explore (search) tab inside Instagram and the InstaEclipse menu slides up. Flip what you want, and most things apply right away. It comes with a companion app too. That is where you see whether the module is running, read its logs, back up your settings, edit themes, and get help. Under the hood, InstaEclipse uses [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) to find what it needs inside Instagram every time Instagram updates, instead of relying on names that change with each build. So when Instagram ships a new version, most features keep working without waiting for a module update. > InstaEclipse is a personal, educational project. It is not affiliated with Meta or Instagram. See the [Disclaimer](DISCLAIMER.md). --- ## Features Everything here is a switch in the menu. Tap a section to open it.
👻 Ghost Mode: browse without leaving footprints
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Hide DM seen | Read messages without sending a read receipt | | Read receipts for specific chats | Keep Hide DM seen on for everyone, but still send "Seen" in the chats you pick (set it from the chat's InstaEclipse menu) | | Hide typing indicator | Type without the other person seeing the dots | | Hide story views | Watch stories without appearing in the viewer list | | Mark a story as seen | Send the view for one story on purpose, from the story menu | | Hide live presence | Join lives without being counted | | Bypass screenshot detection | Screenshot disappearing media without the other person being told | | Hide view once opened | Open view once media without marking it as opened | | Spoof last seen | Freeze your "active" status | | Airplane mode | Appear offline: Instagram stops its live connection while you browse | | Quick toggle | Turn Ghost Mode on and off from a ghost icon next to your inbox |
💬 Messages: keep what matters in your chats
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Keep disappearing messages | Stop ephemeral messages from deleting themselves | | Log unsent messages | When someone unsends a message, keep a private copy, grouped per chat and named after it | | Edit history | See every earlier version of a message that was edited | | Chat export | Export a chat to a readable HTML page with replies, reactions, edit history and optional media | | Jump to first message | Scroll a chat all the way back to its first message | | Ask before calling | Tapping a chat's audio or video call button asks first, so calls never start by accident | | Allow screenshots in DMs | Take screenshots where Instagram blocks them | | Unlock view once and view twice | Replay view once media instead of it disappearing | | Voice message downloads | Save voice messages, named by sender | | Sticker and GIF downloads | Save stickers and GIFs from chats in their original format, named by sender | | DM photos and videos | Instagram's Save on a photo or video in a chat goes through InstaEclipse: named after the sender, in their folder, at the best quality | | Translate messages | Send a message to your translator app from its long press menu (under More) | | Unsend multiple messages | Long press one of your messages, then More, Unsend multiple: check your messages right in the chat and unsend them all at once | | Hide specific chats | Hide chats from your inbox and manage them later | | Hide the Notes tray | Remove Notes from the top of your inbox | | Hide Blend in chats | Remove the Blend button from the chat header | | Hide "Create group" | Remove it from the share sheet | All chat tools live in one InstaEclipse button in the chat header, next to the back arrow.
📖 Stories: see everything a story holds
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Story Info | Exact posted, expiry and edit times, music, location, hashtags, reshared from, original post or reel, posting app, alt text, size, countdowns, questions, Add Yours (exact joined count and top people), paid partnership and collaborators. Tap any line to copy it | | Music links | Open the song in Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music, from Story Info, or from Media info on posts and reels | | Poll, slider and quiz results | Results drawn as bars, your own answer marked, and the correct quiz answer in green | | Copy story links | Copy the links from link stickers, or pick from a list when there are several | | Story tray | Make the story tray smaller so more stories fit in a row, and pick the color of the ring around unseen stories (a preset, your own color or a two-color gradient) | | Hide the story tray | Keep the feed, lose the story row | | View story mentions | See every @mention at once. Tap to copy, hold to open the profile | | Search your story viewers | A search box over your viewer list | | Disable story auto swipe | Stories stop advancing on their own | | Download a whole highlight | From the highlight's long press menu |
🎬 Reels: watch on your terms
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Playback speed | 0.5x to 3x for reels, stories and feed videos | | Hold for slow motion | Hold the left side of a reel for 0.5x, the right side for 2x | | Always show the seek bar | Scrub through any reel | | Reels auto scroll | Move to the next reel when one ends | | Lock Reels scrolling | Stop accidental swipes |
📥 Downloads and media: save and share anything
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Download posts, reels and stories | Single photos, full carousels, reels, and stories (your own included, with music), always at the best quality available | | Download profile pictures | Long press a profile picture to see the full-size original, square, and save it | | Audio only | Save just the audio of a video or reel as .m4a, including a post's music | | Copy media link | Copy the direct link for a post, reel or a single carousel slide | | Copy image | Copy a photo straight to the clipboard | | Media info | Resolution, file size, the song with streaming links, and an option to open the file in another app | | Download with InstaEclipse | Share a post or reel link from any app to download it | | Story cache | Keep stories you watched for 24 hours, so you can save ones that expired | | Save Instants | Long press an Instant to save it | | Upload Instant from gallery | Send a picture from your gallery as an Instant | | Download folder | Choose the folder, sort into a folder per account, and add the date to file names |
🎞️ Quality: the best Instagram has
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Force Reels quality | Pick a fixed quality (Auto, 360p to 1080p, or Max) | | High resolution images | Load the sharpest version of every photo | | Max upload quality | Always upload at the highest quality | | Spoof device | Instagram sees a Pixel 11 Pro XL or Galaxy S26 Ultra, which unlocks HDR video downloads and other features it limits to those phones. Adds the matching developer options |
✨ Feed: see the people you actually follow
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Following only feed | Show only posts from accounts you follow | | Hide suggestions | Remove suggested posts, reels and accounts | | Hide Threads suggestions | Drop the Threads promos | | Hide posts you already liked | Skip what you have seen | | Hide community notes | Remove notes added under posts and reels | | Disable Discover People | Remove the "people you may know" row | | Always show full captions | No more "... more" | | Exact dates | "17 Oct 2026 07:36" instead of "2h ago", in the date format you pick (presets or your own pattern) | | Photo zoom | Long press a photo to zoom in | | Rounded posts | Round the corners of photos and videos in the feed (8 to 24 dp) | | Ask before refreshing | Pulling the home feed down asks before it reloads, so an accidental pull doesn't lose your place | | Disable video autoplay | Videos wait for a tap |
❤️ Likes, comments and profiles
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Disable double tap to like | No accidental likes, in posts, comments and DMs | | Undo a like | A few seconds to take a like back | | Disable repost | Keep the repost button from reposting | | Comment search | Search a post's comments, load them all, and export them | | Copy comments and captions | Copy any comment, or a caption with or without hashtags | | Translate | Translate captions, comments and chat messages with your own translator app | | Save comment GIFs and images | Download the media in comments | | "Follows you" label | See on any profile whether they follow you back | | Fancy bio fonts | The bio's "Change font" button picks a style for what you type next: bold, italic, script, monospace and more; strikethrough and underline work in any language | | Follower toast | A quick message when you open a profile | | Export followers and following | Save the whole list as CSV | | Followers history | See who unfollowed you and who followed you since your last check | | Saved on your profile | A Saved button right on your profile | | Lock Saved collections | Put a passcode on a collection | | Hide the Threads button | Remove it from profiles |
🧭 Navigation: arrange Instagram's tabs
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Hide tabs | Hide Home, Reels, Create, Messages, Activity or Profile | | Tab order | Put the bottom tabs in any order | | Startup tab | Choose which tab Instagram opens on | | Disable swipe to camera | Stop the camera from opening on a swipe |
🔒 Privacy and security
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Lock the whole app | Passcode or fingerprint to open Instagram | | Lock DMs | Lock just the inbox, and optionally lock it again every time you leave | | Block ads and analytics | Drop sponsored posts and tracking calls | | Disable tracking links | Strip only the tracking parts from links you share | | Don't save searches | Profiles, tags and places you open from Search stay out of Recent, on the phone and on Instagram's server | | Location spoofing | Pick any place on a map; Instagram sees that location everywhere |
🎨 Appearance: make it yours
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Custom theme | Presets or your own colors for every part of the app, applied live | | Light and dark themes | Every theme has both versions and follows your phone | | Themed menus | InstaEclipse's own menus, toggles and dialogs use your theme's accent color | | Custom font | Use any .ttf or .otf across the app | | Custom emoji | Swap in another emoji font |
🧘 Distraction Free: quiet the parts that pull you in
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Turn off sections | Stories, Feed, Reels (or all Reels except in DMs), Explore and Comments, one by one | | Extreme mode | Lock those choices in until you reinstall | | Remove Meta AI | Take Meta AI out of search, chats and reels | | Hide onboarding prompts | Skip the nag screens | | Hide Instagram Plus upsells | No more Plus prompts |
🛠️ App, accounts and tools
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Developer Options | Instagram's hidden internal panel, with config import, export and a known good default | | Unlimited accounts | Add more accounts than Instagram allows | | Open links externally | Use your own browser instead of Instagram's | | Custom share domain | Share links with a different domain | | Notification fix | Repair notifications that stopped arriving | | Auto clear cache | Clear Instagram's media cache once it gets too big | | Backup and restore | All settings to a file and back | | Feature toasts | See which features loaded when Instagram starts |
📱 Companion app
| Feature | What it does | |---|---| | Home dashboard | Module status, Instagram version, quick launch and restart, and your pinned shortcuts | | Feature search | Find any switch by name | | Live logs | Hook status from Instagram and the app, no adb needed | | Help | Frequently asked questions, setup links for Vector and LSPatch, and the community | | 18 languages | English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Indonesian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish and Vietnamese |
--- ## Compatibility | | | |---|---| | **Tested on** | Instagram `451.0.0.20.80` | | **Get this version** | [Instagram 451.0.0.20.80 on APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/instagram/instagram-instagram/instagram-451-0-0-20-80-release/) | | **Survives updates** | Yes, DexKit finds what it needs at runtime | | **Android** | 9 and newer | | **Frameworks** | Vector 2.2 or newer (root), LSPatch 1.0 or newer (no root) | A big Instagram update can still knock a feature out until it is patched. The menu inside Instagram shows how many features are active (for example "62/62 active"); tap it to see which ones could not attach. If something breaks right after an update, check the [Telegram channel](https://t.me/InstaEclipse) first. --- ## Installation > Get Instagram [451.0.0.20.80 from APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/instagram/instagram-instagram/instagram-451-0-0-20-80-release/) rather than the Play Store. The Play build is not always fully supported. Download the latest InstaEclipse APK from [**Releases**](https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/releases/latest), then follow the path for your phone. InstaEclipse uses the new Xposed API (102), so it needs Vector 2.2 or LSPatch 1.0 or newer. ### Rooted, with Vector > Needs [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/releases/latest) 2.2 or newer, JingMatrix's Xposed framework. 1. **Install InstaEclipse** from the APK you downloaded. 2. **Enable the module.** In the Vector manager, open Modules, enable InstaEclipse and tick Instagram. 3. **Restart Instagram.** Force stop it and open it again. 4. **Open the menu.** Long press the Explore (search) tab. > [!CAUTION] > Using Hide My Applist? Do not hide InstaEclipse from Instagram. Instagram needs to see it, or the menu text goes missing and features stop working. ### No root, with LSPatch > Needs [JingMatrix's LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch/releases/latest) 1.0 or newer. 1. **Install InstaEclipse** from the APK. 2. **Install LSPatch** (the JingMatrix fork). 3. **Patch Instagram.** In LSPatch, tap **+**, pick the Instagram APK or the installed app, choose **Local Patch Mode**, turn on **Inject loader dex**, then tap **Start Patch**. 4. **Install the patched APK** and log in. 5. **Enable the module.** In LSPatch, open Manage, pick Instagram, open Modules and enable InstaEclipse. 6. **Open the menu.** Long press the Explore (search) tab. There is also a [step by step guide](https://t.me/instaEclipse_discussion/158/5149) in the community. --- ## Using it - **Open the menu:** long press the Explore (search) tab inside Instagram. - **Find things:** sections are grouped into Appearance, Privacy, Media, Social and Tools. Each shows how many of its switches are on. - **Chat tools:** open any chat and tap the InstaEclipse button next to the back arrow. - **Story tools:** open a story and tap its ⋯ menu for Story Info, links, mentions and results. - **Back:** the phone's back button steps back one page at a time. Updates and tips: - 📢 Announcements: [Telegram channel](https://t.me/InstaEclipse) - 💬 Questions and help: [Telegram group](https://t.me/instaEclipse_discussion) --- ## FAQ **A feature is not doing anything.** Disable and enable the module again in Vector or LSPatch, then force stop and reopen Instagram. **The text in the InstaEclipse menus is missing.** Turn off Hide My Applist (HMA) for Instagram. InstaEclipse reads its text from its own app, and HMA hides it. **Some features will not work even when they are on.** Instagram's own config can block them. Open Developer Options and choose Restore Default Config. The same config is also on [Telegram](https://t.me/InstaEclipse/52). **Developer Options labels show up as numbers.** That happens on Instagram's Stable build. Use a Beta or Alpha build from APKMirror. **I turned on Distraction Free but the content is still there.** Force stop Instagram and clear its cache, then open it again. **It does not work on the Play Store version.** Install [Instagram 451.0.0.20.80 from APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/instagram/instagram-instagram/instagram-451-0-0-20-80-release/) instead. **Still stuck?** Ask in the [Telegram group](https://t.me/instaEclipse_discussion). Someone will help. --- ## Contributors
### Maintainer
ReSo7200

### Everyone who has pitched in Made with contrib.rocks
**Thank you** to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol) for the extras, security and performance work in this release, to [izadiegizabal](https://github.com/izadiegizabal) for own story downloads, and to everyone who translated InstaEclipse into their language.
--- ## Built with - [JingMatrix/Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector), the Xposed framework it runs on - [JingMatrix/LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch), for phones without root - [LuckyPray/DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit), which finds Instagram's code at runtime --- ## Contributing Pull requests, bug reports, ideas and translations are all welcome. - Found a bug? [Open a bug report](https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/issues/new/choose) - Have an idea? [Request a feature](https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/issues/new/choose) - Want to build something? Fork the repo and open a pull request ---
Made with care by the InstaEclipse community.
Not affiliated with Meta or Instagram. See the Disclaimer.
readmeZh:
InstaEclipse

Instagram，如您所愿。
用于隐私、下载、更清晰的提要、更智能的故事和 DM 以及您自己的外观的 Vector (Xposed) 模块。 Instagram 内的一切都是开关。

功能 • 兼容性 • 安装 • 使用它 • 常见问题解答 • 贡献者

---

## 这是什么 InstaEclipse 是 [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector)、以前称为 LSPosed（root 手机）的 Xposed 框架和 [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch)（无 root）的模块。长按 Instagram 内的“探索”（搜索）选项卡，InstaEclipse 菜单会向上滑动。翻转你想要的东西，大多数东西都会立即应用。 它还附带一个配套应用程序。您可以在其中查看模块是否正在运行、读取其日志、备份设置、编辑主题以及获取帮助。 在幕后，每次 Instagram 更新时，InstaEclipse 都会使用 [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) 在 Instagram 中查找所需的内容，而不是依赖于每次构建时都会更改的名称。因此，当 Instagram 发布新版本时，大多数功能无需等待模块更新即可继续运行。 > InstaEclipse 是一个个人教育项目。它不隶属于 Meta 或 Instagram。请参阅[免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)。 --- ## 特点 这里的一切都是菜单中的开关。点击一个部分将其打开。 <详情> 👻幽灵模式：浏览不留足迹
|特色|它有什么作用 | |---|---| |隐藏已看到的 DM |阅读消息而不发送已读回执 | |阅读特定聊天的收据 |保持隐藏 DM 对所有人可见，但仍会在您选择的聊天中发送“已看到”（从聊天的 InstaEclipse 菜单中设置）| |隐藏打字指示器 |在其他人看不到这些点的情况下打字 | |隐藏故事视图 |观看故事而不出现在观看者列表中 | |将故事标记为所见 |有意从故事菜单发送一个故事的视图 | |隐藏现场状态 |不被计数地加入生活 | |绕过截图检测 |屏幕截图在不通知其他人的情况下消失媒体 | |打开后隐藏视图 |打开查看一次媒体而不将其标记为已打开 | |最后出现的恶搞 |冻结你的“活跃”状态| |飞行模式 |离线显示：Instagram 停止实时连接浏览时的化解 | |快速切换|通过收件箱旁边的幽灵图标打开和关闭幽灵模式 | <详情> 💬消息：在聊天中保留重要内容
|特色|它有什么作用 | |---|---| |消息不断消失 |阻止临时消息删除自身 | |记录未发送的消息 |当有人取消发送消息时，保留一份私人副本，按聊天分组并以其命名 | |编辑历史|查看已编辑邮件的每个早期版本 | |聊天导出 |将聊天导出到可读的 HTML 页面，其中包含回复、反应、编辑历史记录和可选媒体 | |跳转至第一条消息 |将聊天一直滚动回到其第一条消息 | |致电前询问 |点击聊天的音频或视频通话按钮会首先询问，因此通话绝不会意外开始 | |允许在私信中截屏 |在 Instagram 屏蔽的地方截取屏幕截图 | |解锁查看一次，查看两次 |重播一次媒体而不是消失| |语音留言下载|保存语音消息，按发件人命名 | |贴纸和 GIF 下载 |以原始格式保存聊天中的贴纸和 GIF，并按发件人命名 | | DM 照片和视频 | Instagram 的聊天中的照片或视频保存功能通过 InstaEclipse 进行：以发送者的名字命名，保存在他们的文件夹中，且质量最佳 | |翻译消息 |从长按菜单（在“更多”下）向您的翻译应用程序发送消息 | |取消发送多条消息 |长按您的一条消息，然后按“更多”、取消发送多条消息：在聊天中直接查看您的消息并立即取消发送所有消息 | |隐藏特定聊天记录 |隐藏收件箱中的聊天并稍后管理它们 | |隐藏笔记托盘|删除收件箱顶部的注释 | |在聊天中隐藏 Blend |从聊天标题中删除“混合”按钮 | |隐藏“创建群组”|将其从共享表中删除 | 所有聊天工具都位于聊天标题中后退箭头旁边的一个 InstaEclipse 按钮​​中。 <详情> 📖 故事：查看故事所包含的一切
|特色|它有什么作用 | |---|---| |故事信息|准确的发布、过期和编辑时间、音乐、位置、主题标签、转发来源、原始帖子或卷轴、发布应用程序、替代文本、大小、倒计时、问题、添加您的（准确的加入计数和热门人员）、付费合作伙伴和协作者。点击任意行即可复制 | |音乐链接|在 Spotify、YouTube Music 或 Apple Music 中、从故事信息或帖子和卷轴上的媒体信息中打开歌曲 | |投票、滑块和测验结果 |结果绘制为条形，标记您自己的答案，正确的测验答案以绿色显示 | |复制故事链接 |复制链接贴纸中的链接，或者当有多个 | 时从列表中选择 |故事托盘|使故事托盘变小，以便在一行中容纳更多故事，并选择未见过的故事周围的环的颜色（预设、您自己的颜色或双色渐变）| |隐藏故事托盘 |保留提要，失去故事行 | |查看故事提及|立即查看每个@提及。点击复制，按住打开个人资料 | |搜索您的故事观众 |查看者列表上方的搜索框 | |禁用故事自动滑动 |故事不再自行发展 | |下载完整集锦|从突出显示的长按菜单 | <详情> 🎬 Reels：按照您的条件观看
|特色|它有什么作用 | |---|---| |播放速度| 0.5 倍至 3 倍，用于卷轴、故事和视频源 | |按住慢动作|握住卷轴的左侧 0.5 倍，右侧 2 倍 | |始终显示搜索栏 |擦洗任何卷轴 | |卷轴自动滚动 |结束时移至下一个卷轴 | |锁定卷轴滚动|停止意外滑动 | <详情> 📥 下载和媒体：保存和分享任何内容

**打开菜单：** 长按 Instagram 内的探索（搜索）选项卡。 - **查找内容：**部分分为外观、隐私、媒体、社交和工具。每个都显示有多少个开关处于打开状态。 - **聊天工具：** 打开任何聊天并点击后退箭头旁边的 InstaEclipse 按钮​​。 - **故事工具：** 打开故事并点击其 ⋯ 菜单以获取故事信息、链接、提及和结果。 - **后退：**手机的后退按钮一次后退一页。 更新和提示： -
